title: MCCS Movies
intro: Select a theater to view current showtimes and enjoy movies at Camp Lejeune, MCAS New River, or Midway Park theaters.

sections.heading: Private Theater Rentals
sections.markdown:
Reserve one of our theaters for your next private or group event. Perfect for:

• Birthday parties
• Private Showings
• Award Ceremonies
• Dance Recitals
• Graduations
• Musicals
• Concerts

**Reservation costs vary and are determined by group size and event. Deposits are required within two weeks of booking event. Refundable if canceled 72 hours prior to event.**

sections.heading: Select your Package
sections.markdown:
**Package 1 ($5.50)**
• Small popcorn
• Small fountain drink

**Package 2 ($7)**
• Small popcorn
• Small fountain drink
• Small candy

*Add hotdog for $2 each.

sections.heading: Select a movie
sections.markdown:
We provide a monthly updated list of all NDVDs on file. Digital movies may be selected upon request if event is within authorized playdates of movie.

[Browse Movies](https://www.navymwr.org/programs/motion-pictures/ndvd-nssm-program)

sections.heading: Ticket Prices
sections.markdown:
• 5 and Under: Free
• Ages 6 - 11: $5
• Ages 12 and Up: $6

**3D admission is an additional $1 to include the 3D glasses.**
